skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Understand basic theories and problem-setting methods in real estate finance and investment.
Identify, assess, compare, and choose investment opportunities in real estate business.
Evaluate and select appropriate financial channels and create suitable capital sources for real estate investments.
Analyze risks and feasibility in real estate finance and investment activities.
Apply basic spreadsheet tools in financial planning and real estate investment.
Collaborate effectively in group work, showing responsibility and professionalism.
Combine knowledge and skills to present, analyze, and share viewpoints on financial planning and real estate investment.
Work independently with responsibility in group tasks and personal responsibilities.
Present and defend personal views in the field of real estate finance and investment.
Demonstrate social responsibility and professional ethics in the workplace and society.
